items.titulo: OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: An Open-Source Linux Runtime Allowing Agents to Defend Systems Without Downtime
items.resumen: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a pre-release, BSD-licensed eBPF runtime for Linux. AI agents write signed "shields" that block exploit paths on running systems while teams test and roll out real patches. The post OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: An Open-Source Linux Runtime Allowing Agents to Defend Systems Without Downtime appeared first on MarkTechPost .

Release: datasette-agent 0.7a1 I small improvement to Datasette Agent : chat sessions can open an iframe side panel, and that panel can then navigate to different pages. This version improves navigation by fragment hashes, for deeper integration with other Datasette plugins that update fragment hashes when the user interacts with the plugin in a way that changes state. I built this in order to fix some bugs with the much more exciting datasette-charts 0.2a0 release . Tags: datasette-agent , data

items.titulo: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for GitHub Pull Request Review and Fixes
items.resumen: Anthropic's Claude Ship bundles Code Review, PR Steward and Claude Approvals to review, fix and approve GitHub pull requests. Code Review is GA; the other 2 agents are in public beta for Team and Enterprise. The post Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for GitHub Pull Request Review and Fixes appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
items.resumen: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this: In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass.
